description: M0-05 + M0-76. Mirrors the ADR-027 supply-chain policy: exact pins, nothing younger than 3 days, GitHub Actions pinned by SHA with a version comment (config:best-practices). Deliberately bad fixtures are never touched. INACTIVE until the Renovate GitHub App is installed on the repository (OQ-43); the platform majors are covered meanwhile by the platform-upgrade-lane workflow.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions keep their full SHA pin; the release-age gate still applies.
Platform lane (A-25): Node and its types move together.
Platform lane (A-25): the pnpm version in packageManager. Maintainers apply it: the supply-chain keys of pnpm-workspace.yaml are protected paths.
Platform lane (A-25): Nx packages move together.
Platform lane (A-25): Angular packages move together.
Platform lane (A-25): TypeScript and its ESLint parser move together.
Platform lane (A-25): Vitest packages move together.
Platform lane (A-25): ESLint core and its first-party packages.
Platform lane (A-25), from M2: Electron and its tooling. Matches nothing until Electron is installed.
Platform lane (A-25): fastify and its plugins (ADR-004). Matches nothing until fastify is installed.

Platform majors are adopted through a platform-lane issue (the platform-upgrade-lane workflow), which carries the conformance, egress and bundle-budget checklist. Renovate lists them on the dependency dashboard and opens a pull request only on approval. Minor and patch updates are unaffected.
